attackers_goals: Achieve initial access to a company's resources.
description: A suspicious SSO authentication was made by a user.
investigative_actions: See whether this was a legitimate action. Review the external IP/domain involved in the alert. Contact the user whose account is being accessed and verify that they are actually attempting to log in. Check if the login attempt is coming from an unfamiliar location or device. Look for unusual login patterns, such as login attempts at odd hours. Monitor the user's account for further unusual activity.
name: Suspicious SSO authentication

variations.name: Successful SSO authentication with suspicious characteristics
variations.description: A user successfully accessed SSO with some suspicious characteristics that flagged this login attempt as a suspicious login.
